Built `index.html` — a single self-contained to-do app (no external assets).

- **Add:** form submit, trims input, rejects blank/whitespace, `maxlength=500`.
- **Complete:** per-item checkbox toggles done state and strikethrough.
- **Delete:** per-item `×` button.
- **Persistence:** `localStorage` key `todo.items.v1`, loaded on start and saved after every mutation. Corrupt/missing storage falls back to an empty list; storage write failures are swallowed so the session still works.
- **Other:** safe rendering via `textContent` (no HTML injection), remaining/done count, empty state, light/dark styling, keyboard focus styles.

Verified by reading the file back: 262 lines / 6,945 bytes, all required element IDs present, balanced tags, exactly one inline script, localStorage read/write and all three event handlers found, no external `src`/`href` references. All checks passed. Browser execution wasn't available in this sandbox, so verification is structural rather than a live interaction test.
